guide.title: Whales & Big Trades — how to use
guide.thesis: Large FX option expiries (NY 10:00 cut) can act as short-lived magnets via dealer gamma hedging. Whales are the bold ≥$1bn strikes; Big Trades are the still-material ≥$0.5bn prints.
steps: Open Chart → enable Whales and Big Trades toggles (above the candle pane).
Switch Market to an FX pair (EURUSD, USDJPY, …) — boards are FX-native.
Whales (≥ ~$1bn notional) plot as thick magnet lines; Big Trades (≥ ~$0.5bn) as thinner dashed lines.
Read the Whales desk panel for today's NY 10:00 cut board and bold strikes.
Before the cut: expect pinning / congestion near the largest nearby strike if spot is close.
After the cut: influence fades — do not treat a whale strike as a permanent target.
Use History (from Jan 2026) to see how often price tagged a whale within ±0.15% that day.
Combine with Regime + Gamma: whale + call wall confluence is stronger than either alone.
Journal the reaction (pin / slice / ignore) so Experience Replay can score the edge.
Paper only — these notionals are research boards, not executable liquidity.
